items.title: Does Deliberation Debias? Exogenous Reasoning Effort and Behavioural Finance Bias in Large Language Model Portfolio Advisors
items.claim: Reasoning effort compresses bias magnitude spread without lowering mean bias in LLM portfolio advisors.

items.title: ATLAS-Finance: Benchmarking AI Agents in Realistic Banking Environments
items.claim: Frontier AI agents pass fewer than eleven percent of realistic investment-banking benchmark tasks.

items.title: The Only Edge Was Memorized in Training: LLM Trading Agents Around Earnings and Bad News
items.claim: No LLM trading agent beats simple pre-earnings or post-bad-news bets without memorized training data.

items.title: AI-generated Investor Views and Portfolio Performance: Evidence from Black-litterman Optimization
items.claim: AI sector views from technical indicators beat market equilibrium until fundamentals or macro are added.

items.title: FinVerify: A Verification Framework for Financial Agents
items.claim: Evidence-grounded verification raises financial-agent claim precision but shrinks gains when authoritative evidence is scarce.

items.title: Explaining Realized Returns: Roll's $R^2$ 40 Years Later
items.claim: Wall Street Journal stated reasons explain 30 to 40 percent of equity return variation out of sample.
